note: Every number and rule here is a PROPOSAL for AICTE to approve or change. None of it is presented as an AICTE regulation. Changing it changes behaviour without code changes.

order_of_checks: AICTE's own bank (statement line, remitter details)
institution, only when bank evidence conflicts with the register
confirmations.note: v4 proposed annual confirmation by every institution. v5 drops it: institutions are contacted only when bank evidence conflicts with the register.

payments.window_source: RTGS: credit within 30 min or return within 1 h of receipt (SBI RTGS FAQ). NEFT: return within 2 h of batch completion, N10 credit acknowledgement (RBI circular DPSS CO EPPD No.168, 5 Feb 2010; page lists it under withdrawn notifications, so AICTE's bank must confirm current timelines).
payments.finance_bank_note: AICTE Finance's own banker: the only bank whose debit advices and beneficiary name look-ups are accepted (RBI name look-up is run by the remitter's bank). Proposed; AICTE to confirm.
